razao: Scanalyzer3d involves cyclic permutations of cars, creating a massive state space where traditional heuristics can get stuck in plateaus. A portfolio incorporating width-based/novelty search alongside delete-relaxation and landmarks provides the necessary exploration to efficiently find plans and return cars to their initial locations while fulfilling analysis goals.
